case_name: Smt. Sunita v. Shri Rajesh — full case name
facts_of_case: The parties were married for 10 years and had two children. The wife claimed that the husband was cruel and deserted her. She sought divorce and custody of the children.

legal_principles.principle: A marriage is a sacred institution and the parties to it have a duty to maintain its sanctity.
legal_principles.held: It is settled law that a marriage is a sacrament and the parties to it have a duty to maintain its sanctity. The burden lies on the party seeking divorce to prove that the other party has failed to discharge this duty.
cited_cases: Chandrasekhar v. Union of India, (1974) 1 SCC 74
use_in: cases involving divorce on grounds of adultery or desertion
